integrity: Analytic finite- and infinite-risk claims supported by proof and a standalone, reproducible finite checker. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only one two-residual scalar affine contraction extrapolation with deterministic distinct input sites and independent Gaussian evaluation noise. Nonzero midpoint offset is required for the unique fourth-order ridge coefficient; this optimum is for fixed lambda/sigma², not a global finite-noise optimizer. Higher-dimensional, adaptive, or correlated-noise claims are not established. Algorithmic regularization and Cauchy-type normal ratios are established prior knowledge.
title: Sharp Gaussian ridge-risk law for two-point Anderson mixing
